npcs.name: Elder Sella
knowledgeLimits: Sella did not see who moved the bell.

replies.text: Elder Sella: At dawn I found a trail of blue marsh clay leading away from our shrine. We did not take Brackenford's bell.
Elder Sella: Your questions sound like accusations. Look at the shrine trail before you judge us.
Elder Sella: Bring me something more than rumors, and I may tell you what I noticed at dawn.
Elder Sella: The shrine remains open to anyone willing to examine the ground.

npcs.name: Warden Tovin
knowledgeLimits: Tovin only heard the accusation secondhand.

npcs.name: Mira Fen
knowledgeLimits: Mira works by the water and does not enter either shrine.

npcs.name: Orin Coil
knowledgeLimits: Orin will not discuss village politics.

features.description: A rain-spotted notice bears both village seals and asks for an impartial settlement.
features.name: dispute notice

features.description: The pale shrine steps are scuffed with fresh blue clay and a dragged groove.
features.name: shrine steps

features.description: Blue clay cakes the ferry landing beside a snapped length of bell-rope.
features.name: ferry landing

features.description: A ruined tower nest holds the missing bronze bell beneath dry reeds.
features.name: tower nest

monsterDefinitions.description: A broad-winged marsh kite fiercely guards its nest.
monsterDefinitions.name: marsh kite

facts.statement: Elder Sella found blue marsh clay on a trail leading away from Willowbank's shrine.
Warden Tovin heard that Willowbank villagers rang no bell during the night.

fates.text: The marsh villages receive a settlement grounded in the bell's true path.

narration.text: You present the ferry evidence and ask both villages to share the bell's repair cost.

consequences.text: Willowbank and Brackenford jointly mend the rope and hang the recovered bell between their roads.

narration.text: You return the bell to Brackenford while clearing Willowbank of theft.

consequences.text: Brackenford takes back its bell and publicly withdraws the accusation against Willowbank.

choices.label: Return the bell and clear Willowbank

title: The Bell Beneath the Reeds
objective: Trace the missing bell's path and settle the dispute between Brackenford and Willowbank.

discoveries.title: A public quarrel
discoveries.lead: Follow the marsh route between the two villages.
discoveries.summary: The notice says Brackenford's bronze bell vanished overnight, and Willowbank is accused of stealing it.

discoveries.title: Clay trail
discoveries.lead: Compare the clay with the ferry landing.
discoveries.summary: Fresh blue marsh clay and a dragged groove leave Willowbank's shrine toward the river.

discoveries.title: Snapped bell-rope
discoveries.lead: The rope points toward the abandoned bell tower.
discoveries.summary: A snapped bell-rope lies in the blue clay at the ferry; its frayed end shows the bell was dragged through the marsh, not carried by villagers.

discoveries.title: Bell in the nest
discoveries.lead: Return to Brackenford with the bell's true story.
discoveries.summary: The missing bell is lodged in a marsh kite's tower nest, hauled there after the ferry rope snagged it.

locations.description: Villagers argue beneath the empty wooden bell frame.
locations.name: Brackenford Square

locations.description: Willows shade a small shrine beside the marsh road.
locations.name: Willowbank Green

locations.description: A rope ferry rocks beside a muddy, reed-choked landing.
locations.name: Reed Ferry

locations.description: A leaning stone tower rises from a quiet island of reeds.
locations.name: Old Bell Tower

introduction: Brackenford accuses neighboring Willowbank of stealing its bronze bell. Both villages have asked you to find the truth before the quarrel becomes a feud.

searches.text: The notice sets out the charge and the need for a neutral witness.
You trace blue clay and a dragging mark from the shrine toward the river.
The snapped rope and muddy groove show that the bell was dragged downriver toward the old tower.
Beneath the reeds, you find Brackenford's bell caught in the kite's nest.
